rows.quote: Retiring in 2017 were: Sandra Curley, Susan Diamantopoulos, Steve Kyajohnian, Claudette LaChance, Joanne Londa, Marie Martin, Sharon McCullah, Lisa Stone, and Cathy Zayka.
